title: Bogotá SEO Opens in Colombia, Bringing Google Rankings, WhatsApp-Ready Websites and AI Agents to Bogotá Businesses in Their Own Spanish
verification: Statements are attributed to the subject. Publication is not verification.

claims.statement: Bogotá SEO launched at bogotaseo.com in October 2026, offering SEO, local SEO and Google Business Profile management, websites, Google and Meta advertising, and AI agents to businesses in Bogotá and across Colombia.
Bogotá SEO serves clients in Colombian Spanish over WhatsApp, and its site has a Spanish and English version.
Bogotá SEO offers a free SEO audit covering how a business appears in Google, Google Maps and AI answers, its mobile speed and whether its website converts.
Bogotá SEO is run by Stephany, who was born in Colombia, grew up in Bogotá and moved to the United States in her mid-teens.
Bogotá SEO is operated by Eye To Ad Media, a Denver marketing and web development firm founded in 2012.
